name: penitence
description: A Blasphemous-like 2D action-platformer: parry combat, an interconnected map, and a penance system.

scripts.android:key: mkdir -p android/keystore && keytool -genkeypair -v -keystore android/keystore/penitence.jks -alias penitence -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 -storepass penitence -keypass penitence -dname "CN=Penitence, OU=Game, O=Penitence"
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd .. && mkdir -p release && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk release/penitence-1.0.apk && echo "APK -> release/penitence-1.0.apk"
